g.data-tip: Amazon RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL) — Staffing, HR, timesheet, payroll, CRM. AWS DMS CDC streams only changed rows downstream — no full reloads. Watermark columns track incremental position.
S3 Landing Zone — PDF invoices, POs, and contracts dropped to S3. S3 event notifications trigger Lambda for document processing immediately on upload.
Semi-Structured Sources — Approval emails and Excel trackers. Lambda parses, normalises, and writes to S3 raw zone for Glue processing.
Timesheet & Payroll — Dedicated HR/payroll systems. CDC via AWS DMS captures row-level changes. Finance and billing data reconciled downstream in Glue PySpark.
Approval Portals — Approval workflows and vendor portals. API pulls via Lambda on schedule. Documents stored to S3 landing zone with source metadata tags.

svg.text: Layer 2 — Ingestion (Glue + EventBridge + DMS) & Layer 3 — Document Processing (Textract)

g.data-tip: AWS Glue ETL — Parameterised Glue jobs with Glue Job Bookmarks (prevent duplicate ingestion). Watermark columns for incremental load from RDS. Crawlers auto-update Data Catalog schema on each run.
AWS DMS Change Data Capture — Replicates only changed rows from RDS sources. Propagates inserts, updates, and deletes to S3 in near-real-time. CDC pattern avoids full-table scans.

Amazon Textract (Async) — StartDocumentAnalysis via SNS completion notification. Extracts invoice fields, PO numbers, contract dates, key-value pairs with confidence scores from PDFs and scanned images. Results logged to DynamoDB.
Amazon EventBridge — S3 event notifications trigger Lambda for document sources. EventBridge rules start Glue jobs for scheduled ingestion. Central event bus coordinating all ingestion pipelines.

AWS Lambda — Invoked by S3 events for document sources. Calls Textract async API. Result Lambda processes SNS completion and writes JSON to S3 processed zone. DynamoDB records confidence scores and extraction metadata.
Bronze Layer (Raw) — Full fidelity, source-format snapshots. KMS CMK encrypted. S3 Object Lock (immutable). Audit trail — reprocessing always starts here. Partitioned by ingest_date.
g.text: KMS encrypted · S3 Object Lock · Full fidelity · Append-only

g.data-tip: Silver Layer (Processed) — Cleaned Parquet. Deduplicated, conformed schemas, validated records. Athena-queryable. Glue Data Catalog schema updated on each write.
Gold Layer (Curated) — Business entities: Invoice, Project, Employee, PO, Timesheet. Calculated KPIs: billing margin, approval lag, PO balance. Delta Lake format. Served to RAG + Power BI.
g.text: Invoice · Project · Employee · PO · Timesheet KPIs · Delta Lake

g.data-tip: Entity Resolution — PySpark deterministic key matching identifies the same client or employee across HR, CRM, and payroll systems. Deduplication produces single authoritative record per entity.

Glue Data Quality — Completeness checks (no null invoice IDs), uniqueness constraints, referential integrity (employee exists in HR before timesheet). Quality log written to DynamoDB; CloudWatch alarm on failure.

KPI Calculation — Billing margin = (invoiced − cost) / invoiced. Approval lag = approval_timestamp − submission_timestamp. PO balance = committed − consumed. All calculated in PySpark and written to Gold layer.
g.text: Billing margin · Approval lag · PO balance

g.data-tip: Amazon Redshift — Curated layer feeds star schema in Redshift for SQL reporting. Redshift Spectrum queries S3 Gold directly for ad-hoc analysis without loading. Also feeds the Power BI dashboards.

svg.text: Layer 6 — Intelligence: OpenSearch Hybrid RAG + Amazon Bedrock

g.data-tip: Titan Embeddings v2 — 1536-dim vectors. Batch vectorises curated content. CRITICAL: same model used for ingestion AND query-time embedding. Mismatched models produce meaningless similarity scores.

OpenSearch Hybrid BM25 + k-NN — BM25 for exact terms (invoice numbers, employee IDs). HNSW k-NN for semantic meaning. Semantic reranker reorders top-20 candidates. Security trim by IAM role DURING query — never post-retrieval.

Amazon Bedrock Claude 3 Sonnet — Generates grounded natural-language answers with citations to source invoice ID, PO number, timesheet reference. Bedrock Guardrails screen for prompt injection and PII before and after generation.

Power BI — finance dashboards connected to the Redshift curated layer. Row-level security limits finance managers to their own entity data. Billing pipeline, margin analysis, utilisation and exception views.
IAM Identity Center — Centralised SSO. JWT: user_id, role, entity scope. All service-to-service calls use IAM Roles (no stored credentials).
AWS Lake Formation — Column and row-level access control on Glue Data Catalog tables. Finance managers cannot access HR PII columns even if they query the same Gold table.
VPC PrivateLink — All AWS services (Bedrock, OpenSearch, Glue, Textract, S3) accessed via private endpoints. No traffic traverses public internet.
KMS CMK per tenant — Each business unit has its own Customer Managed Key. Cross-tenant cryptographic isolation. Key rotation every 365 days.
CloudTrail + CloudWatch — Full API audit trail. Every Bedrock, Glue, OpenSearch, and S3 invocation logged. CloudWatch alarms on Glue Data Quality failures and RAG relevance score drops.
Secrets Manager — All credentials (RDS passwords, API keys, Bedrock endpoints) stored with 30-day auto-rotation. K8s External Secrets Operator syncs into Kubernetes Secret objects.
